svg.title: kind-vault-lab architecture
svg.text: Everything below the laptop line runs in OrbStack's Docker; both stacks share the "kind" docker network
task up / task smoke / task audit
kubernetes auth: ns + SA identity | jwt auth: adds pod name (ledger-N)
each pod mounts a projected token, audience "bao", plus the bao-ca ConfigMap
• signs SA tokens (its public key is pinned in bao's jwt-k8s mount)
workers' kubelets project tokens (aud=bao) into pods
both: ns allow-list, aud=bao, no default policy,
5 min token TTL, identity via entity-alias metadata
dev only. Production: KMS / transit auto-unseal
terraform + task: https://bao.orb.local (OrbStack HTTPS) — also kubeconfig to the API server
